headline: AMD Reports Surge in Q3 Data Center Revenue
summary: Advanced Micro Devices reported strong quarterly revenue driven by its data center sector, which surged 97% year-over-year to $8.5 billion.
why: Advanced Micro Devices is a major global semiconductor company competing directly in high-performance computing, processors, and AI infrastructure markets.

impacts.name: Advanced Micro Devices
impacts.why: A nearly doubled data center revenue stream significantly bolsters corporate growth prospects and valuation.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Exceptional growth in the data center division beat revenue expectations and underlined accelerating demand for AI-related hardware infrastructure.
